pivotal_result: Sponsor top-line statement for the Phase IIa randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of BEN-2293 in mild-to-moderate atopic dermatitis (trial registration NCT04737304): 91 patients aged 18 to 65 were randomised to 1% BEN-2293 (n = 49) or placebo (n = 42), applied twice daily for 28 days on affected skin up to a maximum of 30% body surface area. The primary endpoint was safety and tolerability, and BEN-2293 was shown to be safe and well tolerated; however, it did not demonstrate a statistically significant effect on the pruritus Numerical Rating Scale (NRS) or Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI) secondary endpoints across the intention-to-treat population.
reason_class: Secondary efficacy endpoints not met in Phase IIa (sponsor top-line statement)
